readme: How bright each colour of the line-up reaches the screen, as a mean over the whole albedo
(0-255, weighted the way the eye weighs the channels).
The recoloured albedos come out darker than the ones the carriers' own materials were drawn
for, and by a different amount on each carrier - the surface detail each carrier supplies has
its own average. build/build-vest-bundles.ps1 measures every albedo and sets the material's
_Color to target / measured, so a colour lands on the same level whichever carrier wears it.
That multiplier replaces the donor's own _Color, which is why the target is what is seen
rather than what is in the texture.
Pouches are not touched by any of this: they carry a material of our own and read correctly.
For reference, the carriers' vanilla albedos average about 80.
Raise or lower a number here and rebuild - no texture is remade.

limits.note: a multiplier outside this range means the recolour, not the level, is wrong
